text: Being the third son of the family and not bred to any trade, my head began to be filled very early with rambling thoughts.
chunks: Being the third son
of the family and not bred
to any trade, my head began
to be filled very early
with rambling thoughts.

text: He asked me what reasons, more than a mere wandering inclination, I had for leaving father’s house and my native country, where I might be well introduced, and had a prospect of raising my fortune by application and industry, with a life of ease and pleasure.
chunks: He asked me what reasons, more than a mere wandering inclination,
I had for leaving father’s house and my native country,
where I might be well introduced,
and had a prospect of raising my fortune
by application and industry, with a life of ease and pleasure.

text: That boy might be happy if he would stay at home; but if he goes abroad, he will be the most miserable wretch that ever was born: I can give no consent to it.
zh: 如果那个男孩呆在家里，他可能会很高兴；但如果他出国，他将成为有史以来最悲惨的不幸者：我不能同意。
chunks: That boy might be happy if he would stay at home;
but if he goes abroad,
he will be the most miserable wretch
that ever was born:
I can give no consent to it.

text: The ship was no sooner out of the Humber than the wind began to blow and the sea to rise in a most frightful manner; and, as I had never been at sea before, I was most inexpressibly sick in body and terrified in mind.
zh: 船刚驶出亨伯河，风就开始吹，海面以最可怕的方式上涨。而且，由于我以前从未出过海，所以我的身体感到难以言表的不适，心里感到恐惧。
chunks: The ship was no sooner out of the Humber than the wind began
to blow and the sea to rise
in a most frightful manner; and,
as I had never been at sea before,
I was most inexpressibly sick in body and terrified in mind.

text: Now I saw plainly the goodness of his observations about the middle station of life, how easy, how comfortably he had lived all his days, and never had been exposed to tempests at sea or troubles on shore; and I resolved that I would, like a true repenting prodigal, go home to my father.
chunks: Now I saw plainly the goodness
of his observations about the middle station of life, how easy,
how comfortably he had lived all his days, and never had been exposed
to tempests at sea or troubles on shore; and I resolved that I would,
like a true repenting prodigal, go home to my father.

text: I warrant you were frighted, wer’n’t you, last night, when it blew but a capful of wind?
zh: 我保证你很害怕，不是吗，昨晚，刮了一阵风？
chunks: I warrant you were frighted,
wer’n’t you, last night,
when it blew
but a capful
of wind?

text: Come, let us make a bowl of punch, and we’ll forget all that; d’ye see what charming weather ’tis now?
zh: 来吧，让我们泡一碗潘趣酒，然后我们就会忘记这一切；你看到现在的天气多么迷人吗？
chunks: Come,
let us make a bowl
of punch,
and we’ll forget all that;
d’ye see what charming weather ’tis now?

text: The sixth day of our being at sea we came into Yarmouth Roads; the wind having been contrary and the weather calm, we had made but little way since the storm.
zh: 出海第六天，我们来到了雅茅斯路。由于风向相反，天气平静，暴风雨过后我们只走了很少的路。
chunks: The sixth day of our being
at sea we came into Yarmouth Roads;
the wind having been contrary and the weather calm,
we had made but little way
since the storm.

text: I had so apparently trampled upon and hardened myself against: I thought the bitterness of death had been past, and that this would be nothing like the first; but when the master himself came by me, as I said just now, and said we should be all lost, I was dreadfully frighted.
chunks: I had so apparently trampled upon and hardened myself against: I thought the bitterness
of death had been past,
and that this would be nothing like the first;
but when the master himself came by me, as I said just now,
and said we should be all lost, I was dreadfully frighted.

text: Any one may judge what a condition I must be in at all this, who was but a young sailor, and who had been in such a fright before at but a little.
zh: 任何人都可以判断我在这一切中必须处于什么样的境地，我只是一个年轻的水手，而且以前也受过这样的惊吓。
chunks: Any one may judge what a condition I must be
in at all this, who was
but a young sailor, and who had been
in such a fright
before at but a little.

text: It was my advantage in one respect, that I did not know what they meant by _founder_ till I inquired.
zh: 从一方面来说，我的优势在于，在我询问之前，我不知道他们所说的_创始人_是什么意思。
chunks: It was my advantage
in one respect,
that I did not know what they meant
by _founder_ till I inquired.

text: Then all hands were called to the pump.
chunks: Then all hands were called
to the pump.

text: I, who knew nothing what they meant, thought the ship had broken, or some dreadful thing happened.
zh: 我一无所知，以为船坏了，或者发生了可怕的事情。
chunks: I,
who knew nothing what they meant,
thought the ship had broken,
or some dreadful thing happened.

text: We were not much more than a quarter of an hour out of our ship till we saw her sink, and then I understood for the first time what was meant by a ship foundering in the sea.
zh: 我们离开船不到一刻钟，就看到她沉没了，然后我第一次明白了船在海中沉没意味着什么。
chunks: We were not much more than a quarter of an hour
out of our ship till we saw her sink,
and then I understood
for the first time what was meant
by a ship foundering in the sea.

text: But my ill fate pushed me on now with an obstinacy that nothing could resist; and though I had several times loud calls from my reason and my more composed judgment to go home, yet I had no power to do it.
zh: 但不幸的命运现在以一种任何人都无法抗拒的固执推动着我。虽然我的理智和更冷静的判断曾多次大声呼唤我回家，但我却没有能力这样做。
chunks: But my ill fate pushed me
on now with an obstinacy that nothing could resist;
and though I had several times loud calls
from my reason and my more composed judgment
to go home, yet I had no power to do it.

text: My comrade, who had helped to harden me before, and who was the master’s son, was now less forward than I.
zh: 以前曾帮助我磨练过的同伴，是主人的儿子，现在却比我不那么前卫了。
chunks: My comrade, who had helped
to harden me before,
and who was the master’s son,
was now less forward
than I.

text: Perhaps this has all befallen us on your account, like Jonah in the ship of Tarshish.
zh: 也许这一切都因为你而降临到我们身上，就像他施船上的约拿一样。
chunks: Perhaps this has all befallen us
on your account,
like Jonah
in the ship
of Tarshish.

text: This indeed was, as I said, an excursion of his spirits, which were yet agitated by the sense of his loss, and was farther than he could have authority to go.
zh: 正如我所说，这确实是他精神上的一次旅行，他的精神因他的失落感而激动不已，而且超出了他有权走的距离。
chunks: This indeed was, as I said, an excursion
of his spirits, which were yet agitated
by the sense of his loss,
and was farther
than he could have authority to go.

text: We parted soon after; for I made him little answer, and I saw him no more; which way he went I knew not.
zh: 不久我们就分手了；因为我没有回答他，我就再也没有见到他。我不知道他往哪边走。
chunks: We parted soon after;
for I made him little answer,
and I saw him no more;
which way he went I knew not.

text: An irresistible reluctance continued to going home; and as I stayed away a while, the remembrance of the distress I had been in wore off, and as that abated, the little motion I had in my desires to return wore off with it, till at last I quite laid aside the thoughts of it, and looked out for a voyage.
chunks: An irresistible reluctance continued to going home; and as I stayed away a while,
the remembrance of the distress I had been
in wore off, and as that abated, the little motion I had
in my desires to return wore off with it,
till at last I quite laid aside the thoughts of it, and looked out for a voyage.

text: I first got acquainted with the master of a ship who had been on the coast of Guinea; and who, having had very good success there, was resolved to go again.
chunks: I first got acquainted with the master of a ship
who had been on the coast
of Guinea; and who,
having had very good success there,
was resolved to go again.

text: I was now set up for a Guinea trader; and my friend, to my great misfortune, dying soon after his arrival, I resolved to go the same voyage again, and I embarked in the same vessel with one who was his mate in the former voyage, and had now got the command of the ship.
chunks: I was now set up for a Guinea trader; and my friend, to my great misfortune,
dying soon after his arrival, I resolved
to go the same voyage again, and I embarked
in the same vessel with one who was his mate in the former voyage,
and had now got the command of the ship.

text: We crowded also as much canvas as our yards would spread, or our masts carry, to get clear; but finding the pirate gained upon us, and would certainly come up with us in a few hours, we prepared to fight; our ship having twelve guns, and the rogue eighteen.
chunks: We crowded also as much canvas as our yards would spread,
or our masts carry, to get clear;
but finding the pirate gained upon us,
and would certainly come up with us in a few hours,
we prepared to fight; our ship having twelve guns, and the rogue eighteen.

text: But laying us on board the next time upon our other quarter, he entered sixty men upon our decks, who immediately fell to cutting and hacking the sails and rigging.
zh: 但下次他让我们在我们的另一处上船时，他让六十个人来到我们的甲板上，他们立即开始切割和砍掉船帆和索具。
chunks: But laying us on board the next time
upon our other quarter,
he entered sixty men upon our decks,
who immediately fell to cutting
and hacking the sails and rigging.

text: The usage I had there was not so dreadful as at first I apprehended; nor was I carried up the country to the emperor’s court, as the rest of our men were, but was kept by the captain of the rover as his proper prize, and made his slave, being young and nimble, and fit for his business.
chunks: The usage I had there was not so dreadful as at first I apprehended;
nor was I carried up the country to the emperor’s court, as the rest
of our men were, but was kept by the captain
of the rover as his proper prize,
and made his slave, being young and nimble, and fit for his business.

text: However, we got well in again, though with a great deal of labour and some danger; for the wind began to blow pretty fresh in the morning; but we were all very hungry.
zh: 然而，尽管费了很大的力气，还冒着一些危险，我们还是又进了井。因为早上风开始吹得很清新；但我们都非常饿。
chunks: However, we got well in again,
though with a great deal
of labour and some danger; for the wind began
to blow pretty fresh in the morning;
but we were all very hungry.

text: My first contrivance was to make a pretence to speak to this Moor, to get something for our subsistence on board; for I told him we must not presume to eat of our patron’s bread.
zh: 我的第一个想法就是假装要和这个摩尔人交谈，以便为我们在船上的生活买点东西。因为我告诉他我们不能擅自吃我们赞助人的面包。
chunks: My first contrivance was to make a pretence
to speak to this Moor, to get something
for our subsistence on board;
for I told him we must not presume
to eat of our patron’s bread.

text: I conveyed also a great lump of beeswax into the boat, which weighed about half a hundred-weight, with a parcel of twine or thread, a hatchet, a saw, and a hammer, all of which were of great use to us afterwards, especially the wax, to make candles.
chunks: I conveyed also a great lump of beeswax into the boat,
which weighed about half a hundred-weight, with a parcel of twine or thread,
a hatchet, a saw, and a hammer,
all of which were of great use to us afterwards,
especially the wax, to make candles.

text: Yes,” says he, “I’ll bring some;” and accordingly he brought a great leather pouch, which held a pound and a half of powder, or rather more; and another with shot, that had five or six pounds, with some bullets, and put all into the boat.
zh: 是的，”他说，“我会带一些来；”因此，他带来了一个大皮袋，里面装有一磅半的粉末，甚至更多。另一个是带枪的，有五六磅重，还有一些子弹，全都装进了船里。
chunks: Yes, ” says he, “I’ll bring some;
” and accordingly he brought a great leather pouch,
which held a pound and a half of powder,
or rather more; and another with shot, that had five or six pounds,
with some bullets, and put all into the boat.

text: After we had fished some time and caught nothing—for when I had fish on my hook I would not pull them up, that he might not see them—I said to the Moor, “This will not do; our master will not be thus served; we must stand farther off.
zh: 我们钓鱼了一段时间，一无所获——因为当我的鱼钩上有鱼时，我不会把它们拉上来，以免他看到它们——我对摩尔人说：“这样不行；我们的主人不会受到这样的服务；我们必须站得远一些。
chunks: After we had fished some time and caught nothing— for when I had fish
on my hook I would not pull them up,
that he might not see them—
I said to the Moor, “This will not do;
our master will not be thus served; we must stand farther off.

text: I could have been content to have taken this Moor with me, and have drowned the boy, but there was no venturing to trust him.
zh: 我本来可以满足于带走这个摩尔人，并淹死这个男孩，但我不敢冒险相信他。
chunks: I could have been content
to have taken this Moor with me,
and have drowned the boy,
but there was no venturing
to trust him.

text: Sallee; quite beyond the Emperor of Morocco’s dominions, or indeed of any other king thereabouts, for we saw no people.
zh: 萨利；远远超出了摩洛哥皇帝的领土，甚至超出了附近任何其他国王的领土，因为我们没有看到任何人。
chunks: Sallee; quite beyond the Emperor
of Morocco’s dominions,
or indeed
of any other king thereabouts,
for we saw no people.

text: Then we give them the shoot gun,” says Xury, laughing, “make them run wey.
zh: 然后我们给他们一把猎枪，”徐里笑着说，“让他们逃跑。
chunks: Then we give them the shoot gun,
” says Xury, laughing,
“make them run wey.

text: Xury was dreadfully frighted, and indeed so was I too; but we were both more frighted when we heard one of these mighty creatures come swimming towards our boat; we could not see him, but we might hear him by his blowing to be a monstrous huge and furious beast.
chunks: Xury was dreadfully frighted, and indeed so was I too;
but we were both more frighted when we heard one
of these mighty creatures come swimming towards our boat; we could not see him,
but we might hear him by his blowing
to be a monstrous huge and furious beast.

text: Xury said, if I would let him go on shore with one of the jars, he would find if there was any water, and bring some to me.
zh: 徐里说，如果我让他带着其中一个罐子上岸，他会看看是否有水，然后给我带来一些。
chunks: Xury said, if I would let him go
on shore with one
of the jars, he would find
if there was any water,
and bring some to me.

text: Says he, “If wild mans come, they eat me, you go wey.
zh: 他说：“如果野人来了，他们就会吃掉我，你就走吧。
chunks: Says he,
“If wild mans come,
they eat me,
you go wey.

text: I did not care to go out of sight of the boat, fearing the coming of canoes with savages down the river; but the boy seeing a low place about a mile up the country, rambled to it, and by-and-by I saw him come running towards me.
zh: 我不想离开小船的视线，因为我担心河里载着野蛮人的独木舟会过来。
chunks: I did not care to go out of sight of the boat,
fearing the coming of canoes with savages down the river;
but the boy seeing a low place
about a mile up the country, rambled to it,
and by-and-by I saw him come running towards me.

text: English traded, I should find some of their vessels upon their usual design of trade, that would relieve and take us in.
zh: 但是那个男孩看到乡间大约一英里处有一个低洼的地方，便漫步向那里走去，不久我看到他朝我跑来。
chunks: English traded, I should find some
of their vessels
upon their usual design
of trade, that would relieve
and take us in.

text: Xury,” says I, “you shall go on shore and kill him.
zh: 英国人进行贸易，我应该根据他们通常的贸易设计找到他们的一些船只，这将缓解并接纳我们。
chunks: Xury,
” says I,
“you shall go
on shore
and kill him.

text: I took the best aim I could with the first piece to have shot him in the head, but he lay so with his leg raised a little above his nose, that the slugs hit his leg about the knee and broke the bone.
zh: 我尽我所能，用第一枚子弹射中了他的头部，但他躺着，腿抬得比鼻子高一点，子弹击中了他膝盖附近的腿，骨折了。
chunks: I took the best aim I could
with the first piece to have shot him
in the head, but he lay so with his leg raised a little
above his nose, that the slugs hit his leg
about the knee and broke the bone.

text: Then Xury took heart, and would have me let him go on shore.
chunks: Then Xury took heart,
and would have me let him go
on shore.

text: However, Xury said he would have some of him; so he comes on board, and asked me to give him the hatchet.
zh: 然而，Xury 表示他会拥有一些。于是他就上船了，并要求我把斧子交给他。
chunks: However,
Xury said he would have some
of him; so he comes
on board, and asked me
to give him the hatchet.

text: I bethought myself, however, that, perhaps the skin of him might, one way or other, be of some value to us; and I resolved to take off his skin if I could.
zh: 然而，我自己想，也许他的皮肤可能对我们有某种价值；但无论如何，他的皮肤可能对我们有某种价值。我决定如果可以的话，把他的皮剥下来。
chunks: I bethought myself, however, that,
perhaps the skin of him might,
one way or other, be of some value
to us; and I resolved
to take off his skin if I could.

text: After this stop, we made on to the southward continually for ten or twelve days, living very sparingly on our provisions, which began to abate very much, and going no oftener to the shore than we were obliged to for fresh water.
zh: 在这一站之后，我们继续向南行驶了十到十二天，我们的食物非常节俭，而且食物开始大大减少，而且上岸的次数并不比我们必须去获取淡水的次数多。
chunks: After this stop, we made on to the southward continually
for ten or twelve days, living very sparingly
on our provisions, which began to abate very much,
and going no oftener to the shore
than we were obliged to for fresh water.

text: When I had pursued this resolution about ten days longer, as I have said, I began to see that the land was inhabited; and in two or three places, as we sailed by, we saw people stand upon the shore to look at us; we could also perceive they were quite black and naked.
chunks: When I had pursued this resolution about ten days longer, as I have said,
I began to see that the land was inhabited;
and in two or three places, as we sailed by,
we saw people stand upon the shore to look at us;
we could also perceive they were quite black and naked.

text: The other creature, frighted with the flash of fire and the noise of the gun, swam on shore, and ran up directly to the mountains from whence they came; nor could I, at that distance, know what it was.
zh: 另一个生物被闪光和枪声吓坏了，游到岸上，然后直接跑到他们来的山上；距离那么远，我也不知道那是什么。
chunks: The other creature, frighted with the flash
of fire and the noise of the gun, swam on shore,
and ran up directly to the mountains
from whence they came; nor could I, at that distance,
know what it was.

text: I would give it them; but made signs for the skin, which they gave me very freely, and brought me a great deal more of their provisions, which, though I did not understand, yet I accepted.
zh: 我会把它给他们；他们给了我很多东西，虽然我不明白，但我还是接受了。
chunks: I would give it them; but made signs for the skin,
which they gave me very freely,
and brought me a great deal more
of their provisions, which,
though I did not understand, yet I accepted.

text: However, they were at a great distance, and I could not well tell what I had best to do; for if I should be taken with a fresh of wind, I might neither reach one or other.
zh: 然而，他们距离很远，我不太清楚我该做什么；因为如果我被一股清新的风吹走，我可能就无法到达其中一个或另一个。
chunks: However, they were at a great distance,
and I could not well tell what I had best
to do; for if I should be taken
with a fresh of wind,
I might neither reach one or other.

text: But, when I observed the course she steered, I was soon convinced they were bound some other way, and did not design to come any nearer to the shore; upon which I stretched out to sea as much as I could, resolving to speak with them if possible.
chunks: But, when I observed the course she steered,
I was soon convinced they were bound some other way,
and did not design to come any nearer to the shore;
upon which I stretched out to sea as much
as I could, resolving to speak with them if possible.

text: Sallee; they then bade me come on board, and very kindly took me in, and all my goods.
zh: 萨利；然后他们请我上船，并非常友善地接纳了我和我的所有物品。
chunks: Sallee;
they then bade me come
on board,
and very kindly took me in,
and all my goods.

text: No, no,” says he: “Seignior Inglese” (Mr.
chunks: No, no,
” says he:
“Seignior Inglese” (Mr.

text: I told him he had been so generous to me in everything that I could not offer to make any price of the boat, but left it entirely to him: upon which he told me he would give me a note of hand to pay me eighty pieces of eight for it at Brazil; and when it came there, if any one offered to give more, he would make it up.
chunks: I told him he had been so generous to me in everything that I could not offer
to make any price of the boat, but left it entirely to him:
upon which he told me he would give me a note of hand to pay me eighty pieces
of eight for it at Brazil; and when it came there,
if any one offered to give more, he would make it up.

text: Todos los Santos, or All Saints’ Bay, in about twenty-two days after.
zh: 大约二十二天后，到达托多斯洛斯桑托斯（Todos los Santos）或诸圣湾（All Saints' Bay）。
chunks: Todos los Santos,
or All Saints’ Bay,
in about twenty-two days after.

text: I had not been long here before I was recommended to the house of a good honest man like himself, who had an _ingenio_, as they call it (that is, a plantation and a sugar-house).
zh: 我来这里没多久，就被推荐到像他一样诚实的好人家里，他有一个“ingenio”，正如他们所说的那样（即种植园和糖厂）。
chunks: I had not been long here
before I was recommended to the house
of a good honest man like himself,
who had an _ingenio_, as they call it
(that is, a plantation and a sugar-house).

text: My stock was but low, as well as his; and we rather planted for food than anything else, for about two years.
zh: 我的库存量很低，他的也一样；我们种植了大约两年的时间是为了食物而不是其他任何东西。
chunks: My stock was
but low, as well as his;
and we rather planted
for food than anything else,
for about two years.

text: I had no remedy but to go on: I had got into an employment quite remote to my genius, and directly contrary to the life I delighted in, and for which I forsook my father’s house, and broke through all his good advice.
zh: 我别无补救办法，只能继续下去：我从事的工作与我的天才相去甚远，而且与我所喜欢的生活完全相反，为此我放弃了父亲的家，并违背了他所有的好建议。
chunks: I had no remedy but to go on: I had got
into an employment quite remote to my genius, and directly contrary
to the life I delighted in, and for
which I forsook my father’s house,
and broke through all his good advice.

text: I had in all probability been exceeding prosperous and rich.
zh: 我很可能曾经非常繁荣和富有。
chunks: I had
in all probability been exceeding prosperous and rich.

text: Lisbon, and he brought them all safe to me to the Brazils; among which, without my direction (for I was too young in my business to think of them), he had taken care to have all sorts of tools, ironwork, and utensils necessary for my plantation, and which were of great use to me.
chunks: Lisbon, and he brought them all safe
to me to the Brazils; among which, without my direction
(for I was too young in my business to think of them),
he had taken care to have all sorts of tools, ironwork, and utensils necessary
for my plantation, and which were of great use to me.

text: To come, then, by the just degrees to the particulars of this part of my story.
zh: 那么，接下来，我们将详细介绍我故事的这一部分。
chunks: To come, then,
by the just degrees
to the particulars
